Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale Transportation: Collector Car Auction Guide

Barrett-Jackson's Scottsdale auction is the world's most famous collector car event, drawing enthusiasts, serious bidders and celebrities to WestWorld of Scottsdale each January. With multi-million-dollar cars crossing the block and huge daily crowds, your transportation choice matters as much as your bidder registration. Here is how to get to WestWorld in the right vehicle, at the rates we actually charge.

The Barrett-Jackson Experience

This is not just an auction. It is a nine-day automotive celebration:

  • Hundreds of vehicles crossing the block
  • Six-figure attendance over the run
  • Celebrity appearances and live national television
  • A lifestyle pavilion of vendors, displays and driving experiences

WestWorld of Scottsdale

Barrett-Jackson transforms this sprawling venue into an automotive city.

Location

  • Address: 16601 North Pima Road, Scottsdale, AZ 85260
  • Dates: January 23–31, 2027
  • Gates: 8:00 a.m. to auction close each day
  • Access: Pima Road at the 101, with event traffic routed through the WestWorld gates
  • From Sky Harbor: Loop 202 to the 101 north

Parking and rideshare

Barrett-Jackson's 2027 Scottsdale page states these arrival options:

  • Complimentary public parking, with shuttles to and from the main gate (Barrett-Jackson 2027 Scottsdale)
  • Valet parking, available for a fee (Barrett-Jackson 2027 Scottsdale)
  • Rideshare drop-off and pick-up in the lot west of Thompson Peak Parkway on McDowell Mountain Ranch Road (Barrett-Jackson 2027 Scottsdale)

WestWorld hosts another marquee event a few weeks later: the Arabian Horse Show in February, with the same gates, the same lots and the same logistics.

Which Vehicle Fits Your Group

At an event celebrating automotive excellence, arriving in a basic rental sends the wrong message. Our fleet is brand new, and every chauffeur is professional and licensed.

Rates are hourly. 7+ hours earns 1 free hour, 12+ hours earns 2, 15+ hours earns 3. 8% tax applies. Checkout shows exactly what is charged today and when any balance is due. Tip is optional — 10/15/20% presets at checkout. It is never added automatically.

The Collector's Choice: Luxury SUV

Up to 6 guests, seamless WestWorld drop-off and room for auction catalogs. An 8-hour auction day bills 7 hours (one free) for $875 before tax, or $945 with tax. Luggage and gear fit confirmed separately.

The VIP Treatment: Maybach Jet Sprinter

Serious bidders choose the 9-seat Maybach Jet Sprinter for executive seating, privacy for pre-auction strategy and refreshments in transit. An 8-hour day is $2,065 before tax ($2,230 with tax), about $229 per person with 9 on board.

The Group Experience: Executive Sprinter

Attending with fellow enthusiasts? The 14-seat Executive Sprinter handles an 8-hour day for $1,015 plus 8% tax. Twelve collectors pay about $85 each; a full 14 pay about $73 each.

The Corporate Group: Mini Bus (24 Pax)

For dealer groups and client entertainment, the Mini Bus (24 Pax) covers a 10-hour day (9 billed hours) for $1,665 before tax, or $1,798 with tax, about $69 per person with 24 aboard. Minimal luggage.

Auction Week Schedule

Preview Days (Saturday to Tuesday)

Lower attendance, the best time for detailed viewing and photography, and the easiest transportation days.

Early Auction (Wednesday to Thursday)

Attendance builds as the docket heats up. Parking is still manageable.

Prime Time (Friday to Saturday)

Headline vehicles cross the block, crowds peak and transportation becomes essential.

Finale (Sunday)

Final marquee lots and celebrity moments. Exit planning is critical.

Sample Collector Itineraries

The Serious Buyer (Luxury SUV)

Preview day

  • 8:00 AM: Hotel pickup
  • 8:30 AM: VIP entrance arrival
  • 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM: Detailed inspection
  • 4:30 PM: Return for a strategy session

Auction day

  • 10:00 AM: Pickup with auction materials
  • 10:30 AM: Arrival ahead of your target lots
  • Post-purchase: Celebration dinner

Each 9-hour day bills 8 hours: $1,000 before tax, $1,080 with tax.

The Enthusiast Weekend (Executive Sprinter)

Friday: 9:00 AM hotel departure, 9:30 AM auction arrival, 5:00 PM pickup, dinner in Old Town.
Saturday: 8:00 AM early arrival for prime lots, 6:00 PM departure, celebratory dinner.

Each 10-hour day bills 9 hours: $1,305 plus 8% tax, about $93 per person with 14 aboard.

The Corporate Day (Mini Bus (24 Pax))

  • 9:00 AM: Client hotel pickups at multiple resorts
  • 10:00 AM: Group arrival at WestWorld
  • Noon: Lunch transfer
  • 6:30 PM: Client dinner at a Scottsdale steakhouse
  • 10:00 PM: Hotel returns

Thirteen hours requested earns 2 free hours and bills 11: $2,035 before tax, $2,198 with tax.

What Collectors Appreciate

  • Bottled water and refreshments
  • Phone charging for live bidding updates
  • Climate control on cool January days
  • Flexible timing when a lot runs long
  • Clean, polished vehicles and well-dressed chauffeurs
  • Discreet service that matches the event

Dining Recommendations

WestWorld food is functional, not memorable. For the real meals:

Pre-Auction Breakfast

  • Upscale-casual breakfast rooms and a lively brunch spot, both a short run from WestWorld
  • A local pancake favorite closer still

Post-Auction Celebrations

  • The steakhouses along Scottsdale Road and in Kierland
  • A resort dining room on the way back to North Scottsdale

Your chauffeur coordinates timing with the auction schedule.

For Sellers and Consigners

Consigning a car changes the logistics. Before the auction we get you to check-in and documentation appointments. On auction day, credentialed consigners get priority access and an immediate departure after the hammer falls. Afterward we cover banking appointments, return trips while the car transfers and the airport run home.

Beyond the Auction

Extend your Scottsdale stay with Verde Valley wine tours, a Grand Canyon excursion, desert golf or Old Town galleries.
